name: Engineering change affected records index
summary: When an engineering change request enters review, the document controller gets one index: the assemblies, revisions, stock and open purchase orders the change reaches in the exports supplied, and a question for each owner wherever the records are unclear.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own design, written from its published map of how a hardware company follows an engineering change into its records: the change request, the bill of materials, the drawing index, stock and open purchase orders, each with set column headers; every revision compared as written; every gap turned into a question for the person who owns the answer.
